W.note: frontage of the main block: plan S01 126 px (b), plates 1 and 2 read on that module (c)

D.note: depth, measured on the photographs P0185-P0189 (measure.py, method d): 8.60 ± 0.42 m; plan 8.6 m, the old box 14 m

H1.note: ground storey to the floor of the main storey, measured on P0185-P0189 (measure.py, second pass): 3.92 ± 0.18 m; also the colonnades' and the octagons' lower cornice, one level by S108 Fig. 8 (B). The plates' module gave 4.5-5.5 m

ridge.note: roof apex under the ridge cap (the ridge line 14.35 m): the roof rises 0.17 of the top storey's width on both plates (54/322 px, 90/538 px), 2.1 m, plus 0.6 m for the plates' view from below the cornice, on the photographs' storey. A full camera fit on the plates gives 15.65 ± 0.32 m, pulled up by their tall top storey (Q219); the dossier's 18.3 m was the plates' module

rail.note: balustrade height: plate 2 draws 1.2 m, heavy for a rail

proj.note: the centre block stands forward of the wings, plates 1 and 2

oct_flats.note: octagon across the flats: plan 8.6 m, plate 1 8.9 m, plate 2 9.0 m
